title: Payment Gateway Setup
description: Learn how to configure payment gateways in Matjrii to accept payments from customers worldwide.
content:
Payment Gateway Setup

Matjrii supports 27+ payment gateways, allowing you to accept payments from customers around the world. This guide will help you set up payment gateways for your store.

Step 1: Navigate to Payment Gateways

From the dashboard, go to Settings → Payment Gateways or click on "Payment Gateways" in the sidebar.

Step 2: Choose Your Payment Gateway

Matjrii supports the following payment gateways:

Global Payment Methods

  • Stripe: Credit/debit cards (Global)
  • PayPal: PayPal account payments (Global)
  • Bank Transfer: Manual bank transfer
  • CoinGate: Cryptocurrency payments

Regional Payment Methods

  • Razorpay: India
  • Paystack: Africa/India
  • Mollie: Europe
  • Payfast: South Africa
  • And 20+ more regional gateways

Step 3: Configure Payment Gateway

Click on the payment gateway you want to configure. You'll need:

  • API Keys: Obtain from your payment gateway provider
  • Secret Keys: For secure transactions
  • Webhook URL: Automatically configured by Matjrii
  • Test Mode: Enable for testing before going live

Step 4: Enable the Gateway

After entering your credentials:

  1. Click "Test Connection" to verify your settings
  2. If successful, toggle the gateway to "Enabled"
  3. Click "Save" to activate

Step 5: Test Your Setup

Before accepting real payments:

  • Place a test order
  • Complete the payment process
  • Verify the order appears in your dashboard
  • Check that webhooks are working correctly

Important Notes

  • Keep your API keys secure and never share them
  • Always test in sandbox/test mode first
  • Some gateways require additional verification
  • Check gateway-specific requirements in their documentation

Next Steps

After setting up payment gateways, learn about the checkout process.
